output.explanation: Expanded ownership-core, the sole supplied diagram, into a central ownership tree and two peripheral continuations: session IO and presentation. The central tree retains bootstrap/shared services, runtime holders, and Surface-owned session state; peripherals deepen the actual Surface-owned branches without making workers owners of the terminal or renderer. No diagrams were left unchanged and there were no existing edges. Checked the pinned checkout and corrected shutdown/reference details: App.deinit directly calls runtime-surface deinit, but GTK's adapter is a no-op; registration does not own wrapper allocation; focused_surface references a core Surface; inspector deactivation clears its borrowed pointer, whereas full teardown frees it after workers join. Explicit edges preserve shared-state, mailbox, font and device relationships.

Ghostty session ownership -- children own; -> borrows or hands off
|
|-- Bootstrap / embedded C API lifetime
|   `-- CoreApp: create/init -> destroy [src/App.zig:80-155]
|       |-- Registry storage, focus, conditional state, notification throttle,
|       |   first-surface flag and mailbox; tick drains messages
|       |   |-- surfaces[] -> runtime surfaces (registration, not allocation)
|       |   `-- focused_surface -> core Surface; validate with hasSurface
|       |-- font_grid_set: app-wide SharedGridSet
|       |   |-- Font library, discovery state and keyed, ref-counted grids
|       |   `-- ref creates/reuses; deref at zero destroys key/grid
|       |       [src/font/SharedGridSet.zig:53-175,413-430]
|       `-- device: lazy shared graphics device; outlives surface renderers
|           [src/Surface.zig:564-570; src/App.zig:145-148]
|
`-- GUI host lifetime (GTK widget tree or embedding host)
    |-- Runtime application: configuration and platform integration
    |   |-- Embedded: cloned Config, lazy keymap, callback options;
    |   |   terminate frees config/keymap [src/apprt/embedded.zig:139-174]
    |   |-- GTK: config, UI/platform resources and event sources;
    |   |   dispose/finalize release [src/apprt/gtk/class/application.zig:1554-1586]
    |   `-- core_app -> CoreApp; no duplicate shared fonts/device
    `-- Runtime surface holder: one widget/host handle per session
        |-- Embedded wrapper owns title, inspector wrapper, core_surface by value;
        |   newSurface allocates; closeSurface deinits AND frees wrapper
        |   [src/apprt/embedded.zig:278-294,447-504,634-648]
        |-- GTK widget owns allocated core_surface; initSurface creates it;
        |   finalize unregisters, deinits and destroys it
        |   [src/apprt/gtk/class/surface.zig:1963-1980,3557-3624]
        |-- -> CoreApp registry: deleteSurface only unregisters
        `-- Core Surface: session owner [src/Surface.zig:477-765,829-880]
            |-- Lifecycle: init builds state/spawns workers; close asks runtime
            |   to destroy. Stop/join search, renderer, IO before freeing state.
            |   Renderer deinit precedes renderer_thread handle destruction.
            |-- -> app / rt_app / rt_surface: enclosing services and host
            |-- Main-thread state: size, focus, visibility, readonly, child exit,
            |   conditional state and command timing [src/Surface.zig:103-187]
            |-- config: owned DerivedConfig; derive/replace/free, no caller pointer
            |-- keyboard: queued writes and active table stack
            |   `-- -> Surface.config bindings; reload drops sequences/tables
            |       [src/Surface.zig:1804-1848,863-876]
            |-- mouse: buttons, selection gesture, scrolling and link tracking
            |   `-- -> terminal pins; gesture deinit before io.deinit (line 855)
            |-- Font lease: key/size/metrics; final deref after renderer deinit
            |   `-- -> CoreApp.font_grid_set; replacement hands old-key release
            |       to renderer mailbox [src/Surface.zig:2536-2572,871]
            |-- io: Termio -- terminal, parser and subprocess [IO detail]
            |-- io_thread + io_thr: execution controller/handle [IO detail]
            |-- renderer_state: shared synchronization/presentation [Render detail]
            |-- renderer: per-surface CPU/GPU resources [Render detail]
            |-- renderer_thread + renderer_thr: scheduling/handle [Render detail]
            |-- search: optional Search {state, thread}; nonempty query creates
            |   |-- State owns loop, mailbox, refresh timer, search/match state
            |   |   and notification progress; end/empty query stops and joins
            |   |-- -> io.terminal + renderer_state.mutex; deinit search under lock
            |   `-- [src/Surface.zig:210-227,5080-5146;
            |        src/terminal/search/Thread.zig:46-79,118-132]
            `-- inspector: optional heap Inspector with GUI/data and mouse state
                |-- Activation allocates; deactivation clears borrowed pointer
                |   under mutex before freeing; full teardown frees after joins
                `-- -> renderer_state.inspector exposes it to IO/rendering
                    [src/Surface.zig:929-955,972-991,858-861]

Shutdown boundary [src/App.zig:136-148; src/apprt/gtk/Surface.zig:15-17]
App.deinit calls runtime-surface deinit, then frees registry storage;
GTK's adapter deinit is a no-op: widget teardown must already close sessions.
App asserts zero font leases, then frees fonts/device; registry != wrapper owner.
Bootstrap/API holders: src/main_ghostty.zig:102-109; src/apprt/embedded.zig:1718-1749

Core Surface / IO branch -- continuation of session ownership
|
|-- io: Termio [src/termio/Termio.zig:313-385]
|   |-- terminal: authoritative mutable Terminal (not owned by workers)
|   |   |-- screens: ScreenSet [src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig:23-112]
|   |   |   |-- all: primary Screen immediately; alternate lazily allocated
|   |   |   |   `-- Each Screen owns pages/scrollback, cursor/saved cursor,
|   |   |   |       selection, charset, keyboard protocol and Kitty images;
|   |   |   |       output/resize mutate; deinit releases storage
|   |   |   |       [src/terminal/Screen.zig:45-87,361-367]
|   |   |   `-- active -> initialized Screen; switchTo borrows, remove frees
|   |   `-- Modes, palette, tab stops, title, cwd, glyph glossary, optional DnD;
|   |       Terminal.deinit releases owned storage
|   |       [src/terminal/Terminal.zig:49-106,395-404]
|   |-- terminal_stream: persistent VT parser + StreamHandler state
|   |   `-- -> terminal + renderer_state.mutex: processOutput locks while parsing
|   |       [src/termio/Termio.zig:313-364,705-765]
|   |-- Owned DerivedConfig, IO mailbox/queued messages, thread_enter_state;
|   |   startup state freed on thread entry; remaining state freed on deinit
|   |-- backend.exec.subprocess: owned launch description, PTY and process
|   |   |-- Arguments/cwd/environment prepared at init; threadEnter starts PTY
|   |   |   and command; successful launch drops env and parent's slave FD
|   |   `-- threadExit stops/reaps; deinit closes PTY and frees launch data
|   |       [src/termio/Exec.zig:196-230,594-624,887-941]
|   |-- -> renderer_state: shared mutex, terminal/inspector references
|   |-- -> renderer_thread mailbox/wakeup: render scheduling and notifications
|   `-- -> surface_mailbox: borrowed route via CoreApp mailbox to this Surface
|
|-- io_thread: controller [src/termio/Thread.zig:44-74,92-136]
|   |-- Event loop, stop handle, scroll/resize-coalescing/sync-output timers
|   `-- -> io / terminal / mailbox: borrows Surface.io, no second terminal
`-- io_thr: OS thread; Surface spawns and joins before controller deinit
    `-- Active stack: CallbackData.data = Termio.ThreadData
        |-- threadEnter initializes; threadExit then data.deinit on return
        |   [src/termio/Thread.zig:259-285; src/termio/Termio.zig:832-851]
        |-- backend.exec runtime resources [src/termio/Exec.zig:493-566]
        |   |-- Process watcher, write stream/queue/pool, termios timer
        |   `-- Reader thread + quit pipe; stop subprocess, signal quit, join,
        |       then release watcher/stream/pool/timer [Exec.zig:196-230,549-566]
        |       `-- POSIX reader stack: bounded rotating Pipeline, idle pipe,
        |           gather thread; gather feeds batches to reader's parser stage
        |           and is joined before reader returns [Exec.zig:1412-1495]
        `-- -> controller loop, Termio mailbox and shared renderer_state

Teardown: join IO before Termio.deinit; release mouse gesture pins first.
Surface owns io and controller independently; worker stack exists only while running.

Core Surface / presentation branch -- continuation of session ownership
|
|-- renderer_state: Surface-managed shared state [src/renderer/State.zig:13-46]
|   |-- Allocated mutex, owned preedit codepoints, mouse rendering state,
|   |   atomic demand/handoff counters; Surface frees allocations after joins
|   |   [src/Surface.zig:590-593,873-875]
|   |-- -> io.terminal: one shared terminal, accessed by IO/UI/render/search
|   `-- -> Surface.inspector: borrowed; cleared under mutex on deactivation
|
|-- renderer: per-surface Renderer [src/renderer/generic.zig:112-290,712-873]
|   |-- CPU state: DerivedConfig, RenderState snapshot, cells/uniforms,
|   |   shaper/cache, search-highlight arenas and optional overlay
|   |   `-- Frame updates refresh copies; deinit releases CPU storage
|   |-- Graphics API state, swap chain/frame resources, shaders, images/background
|   |   |-- releaseGpuResources waits for in-flight frames before freeing chain;
|   |   |   frees shaders when unrealized [generic.zig:1244-1255]
|   |   `-- threadExit marks unrealized, releases GPU resources and images
|   |       before API context teardown [generic.zig:914-943]
|   |-- latest_frame: retained exported frame; replacement releases old frame
|   |   `-- takeFrame -> runtime consumer receives ownership; deinit frees untaken
|   |       [generic.zig:124-131,851,1058-1071]
|   |-- Optional lazy display_link: deinit closes callbacks synchronously
|   |   `-- -> renderer_thread.draw_now; must close before handle is freed
|   |       [generic.zig:853-862,1272-1287; src/Surface.zig:847-853]
|   |-- -> CoreApp.device: borrowed shared graphics resources
|   |-- -> CoreApp.font_grid_set grid: retained by Surface font lease
|   `-- -> surface_mailbox / runtime surface: presentation and UI route
|
|-- renderer_thread: scheduling controller [src/renderer/Thread.zig:30-85]
|   |-- Event loop, owned mailbox, wake/stop/draw handles, render/cursor timers,
|   |   compression state and thread config; deinit after join (lines 177-189)
|   |-- -> renderer / renderer_state / runtime surface: borrowed, not owned
|   `-- Font-grid message -> shared set: accept replacement then deref old key
|       [src/renderer/Thread.zig:397-399; src/Surface.zig:2555-2572]
`-- renderer_thr: OS thread; Surface spawns/stops/joins it
    `-- -> controller; thread exit releases renderer GPU state, not Surface

Teardown [src/Surface.zig:829-876]
Stop/join search, renderer, IO; then renderer.deinit closes display link,
then renderer_thread.deinit frees callback handles. Shared mutex/preedit and
final font lease survive worker shutdown; the app device survives all renderers.
